name: citesync
description: citesync generates and synchronizes software citation metadata across CITATION.cff, CodeMeta, Zenodo and package files using CodeMeta crosswalks. Use the CLI or pre-commit hook to keep repository metadata consistent, or generate citation files in the browser playground. It also checks and updates Typst and Quarto plugin manifests. Imports include Python, Rust, npm, R and Julia package metadata; the CLI and playground also export BibTeX, CSL-JSON, APA, JSON-LD, DataCite XML, RIS and EndNote citations, and the CLI prints CITATION.cff, CodeMeta and Zenodo files made from the source. It flags codemeta.json keys that are not CodeMeta terms, and checks RO-Crate and Croissant dataset files against the source.
